findings.claim: Projector readiness is based on a one-time head offset snapshot, so events published after `head_offset` is read but before readiness is set can leave `/readyz` reporting ready while broker backlog still exists.
findings.evidence: Acceptance requires readiness/backlog correctness: “Establish snapshot-to-WAL catch-up and readiness” and spec scenario says “projector readiness remains false until retained broker backlog is applied”; `run_until_shutdown` captures `catch_up_to` once at lines 62-65 and sets readiness true when `delivered >= head` at lines 79-82 without rechecking the broker high-water mark.
findings.suggested_fix: After reaching the captured head offset, re-read `head_offset` and only set readiness true when the latest high-water mark is still at or below the delivered offset; otherwise continue catching up to the new head.
